## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete trigger and resulting diagnostic behavior. State which data is observed, calculated or inferred.

## Validation

List relevant checks and their actual results. Identify Synthetic fixtures, actual DDS tests and hardware-unverified capabilities separately.

## Review notes

- [ ] Input/output schemas, units, sign conventions and clock domains are accurate.
- [ ] Unknown data and uncertainty remain unknown; no physical synchronization claim exceeds the evidence.
- [ ] Read-only access, cancellation and resource limits remain enforced.
- [ ] Documentation and parser fixtures reflect the implemented interface.
- [ ] No secrets, raw private logs or unsupported hardware performance claims are included.
